scenes.label: sign-in
scenes.line: Renting three items on one order. {0.3} Enter your email to sign in.

scenes.label: new-order
scenes.line: Your order opens empty, so add yourself to it first.

scenes.label: item-catalogue
scenes.line: Open a collection to see what is inside it. {0.3} Each collection holds gear of one kind, so you can compare before you choose. {0.3} Start with the board.

scenes.label: first-dates
scenes.line: Pick the pickup day, then the return day. {0.3} We hold it for every day between.

scenes.label: second-catalogue
scenes.line: Go back to the catalogue for the second item, a ski package this time.

scenes.label: second-dates
scenes.line: Each item gets its own dates, so you can take one out for longer than another.

scenes.label: second-item-added
scenes.line: That is two on the order.

scenes.label: third-catalogue
scenes.line: Once more for the third item. {0.3} There is no limit here — keep adding while the order is still open, and the running total follows along.

scenes.label: third-dates
scenes.line: Dates for the third item, the same way as the others.

scenes.label: the-questions
scenes.line: Now the questions. {0.3} Your height, your boot size, your skill level, your weight and your age. {0.3} You answer these once, and they apply across every item on the order, so three items is no more work than one. {0.3} Then agree to the terms and save.

scenes.label: checkout
scenes.line: One payment covers all three items.

scenes.label: back-to-dashboard
scenes.line: All three rentals sit together in your order history.
